channel.title: Unbroken Closers Field Notes
channel.description: Short, practical sales lessons for managers and reps from LJ Stephens.

item.title: Most People Quit Too Soon
item.description: Most salespeople don't fail. They quit before their habits pay off, because they never tracked the progress they were making.

item.title: The Commission Love Affair
item.description: Falling in love with the commission instead of the customer feels great for one deal. It costs you the career.

item.title: Grow Where You're Planted
item.description: Every rep has a reason they'd sell more somewhere else. The ones who win master the store they're standing in first.

item.title: Why Your Best New Rep Quits in Month Three
item.description: New salespeople rarely quit on day one. They quit when the excitement wears off and the skills haven't caught up. Here's how to spot it and what to say.

item.title: The Two-Minute Morning Huddle That Actually Trains
item.description: Most morning meetings are announcements and sales numbers. Here's a two-minute huddle format that builds one real skill every day.

item.title: Your Customers Got Smarter. Your Reps Need to Catch Up.
item.description: Car buyers research online before they ever visit. Here's what that changes on the sales floor, and the trust-first approach that closes them.
